description: Gallery, web app, and CLI for animated pixel-art pets (mascots) for OpenAI Codex and other coding agents
rules: The npm package is plain `petdex` (unscoped): `npx -y petdex install <slug>`; there is no @crafter/petdex
Always pass -y to npx in scripts; npx's own install confirmation looks like a hang otherwise
The CLI requires Node.js 20+; `petdex login` needs a browser for the OAuth callback
Repo development uses Bun (`bun install`, `bun run dev:docker`); npm/npx commands are for end users of the CLI
